title: Legal & Contract Management for Motor Carriers | BOF
description: BOF manages broker-carrier agreements, shipper contracts, equipment leases, owner-operator leases, vendor agreements, renewals, and contract dispute records.
html:
Contract control

Legal & Contract Management

Motor carriers operate inside broker, shipper, equipment, owner-operator, vendor, and insurance contracts. BOF does not give legal advice; it makes contract records, renewal dates, risk terms, owners, and dispute evidence visible.

Contract Library by Operating Risk

ContractRisk Terms to TrackBOF Control
Broker-carrier agreementIndemnity, cargo claims, offsets, insurance requirements, venueAnnual review, requirement extraction, dispute history.
Shipper direct contractRate, term, service levels, cargo liability, insurance minimumsRenewal calendar and contract KPI evidence.
Equipment loan or leasePayment, balloon, buyout, mileage cap, termination penaltyAsset record and cash-flow obligation link.
Vendor agreementPricing, renewal, service level, insurance, payment termsVendor status and approval owner.

Contract Clearance Path

  1. Capture agreement. Current signed copy, amendment, renewal date, and owner are stored.
  2. Extract terms. Insurance, payment, service, claim, notice, and renewal provisions become review fields.
  3. Assign review. Business owner, legal reviewer, insurance agent, or finance owner gets the next action.
  4. Attach evidence. Approval note, revised term, notice sent, or dispute outcome stays with the record.
